items.title: Being a universal homeomorphism is fpqc local on the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the property of being a universal homeomorphism is fpqc local on the base (statement lines 5933-5937). The author first notes that the statement can be reduced to the corresponding statements for the three component properties, then supplies an explicit route: a map of topological spaces is a homeomorphism exactly when it is injective, surjective and open, so a universal homeomorphism is the same thing as a morphism that is at once surjective, universally injective and universally open, and locality on the base therefore follows from the three separate locality statements (proof lines 5939-5950). The claim is H2: the reduction to three already available locality results is written out, and the characterisation of homeomorphisms is stated rather than assumed.
